'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta John Moorley LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Moorley]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[John Moorley]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-11th-place-ls-john-moorley-proft/ PC list]
